::: {#def-dropout}

#### Dropout

**Dropout** with rate $p$ sets each [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit) of a layer to 0
independently with probability $p$ at each [training step](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-training-step),
and multiplies the [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit)s it keeps by $1 / (1 - p)$.
When the network makes predictions,
dropout leaves the layer unchanged
[@srivastava2014dropout; @goodfellow2016deep, section 7.12].
@srivastava2014dropout write $p$ for the probability of keeping a unit,
and multiply the weights out of the layer at prediction time instead,
which gives the same expected values;
PyTorch's `nn.Dropout` scales during training [@pytorch_dropout].

:::
